briefing: The US and Iran traded strikes across the Gulf on Nov. 18, and Xi greeted Trump at the APEC summit. HHS approved Medicaid waivers for Native American traditional healing in Utah and Maine. Democrats in Georgia, Kansas and Texas see Medicaid expansion as a priority. In Idaho, a legislative report found drug possession prison sentences surged over two decades.
